report_id_rule: BR plus original source-row position, zero-padded to six digits; assigned once before filtering or sorting
date_posted_in_base: Original string values retained; Member 1 converts the prepared table to datetime
source_changes: If the raw file changes, stop and agree a new source version. Never silently regenerate IDs.
shared_preparation_rule: All base rows and original report IDs must remain in reports_prepared.parquet. Exclusions use include_in_analysis and exclusion_reason.
embedding_rule: The two original embedding arrays remain attached to their original report_id. Never sort an embedding matrix independently of its report table.
